text:
Maria H: Quick sync — we need to finalize the client-facing contract for errors this week. Ops and Console want something we can correlate straight to dashboard badges and quota billing. Thoughts?

Chen L: I can start a proposal. big constraints: must be stable for SDKs, and include a small set of machine-readable fields for telemetry sampling.

Samir: Agree. Suggest shape: `code` (numeric), `category` (string: transient|terminal|quota|routing), `hint` (short), `trace_id` (optional), `quota_bucket` (optional). Keep `hint` short so UIs can show single-line messages.

Lee: +1. Also add `route_id` — we need to correlate failures to routing policy (canary vs primary). Otherwise dashboard can't surface which policy is failing.

Anya: UX note — console wants an expansion panel showing the raw error and a one-line friendly phrase. So `hint` should be consumer-friendly, not internal jargon. Example: "service busy, try again in a few seconds" not "rate_limited_primary_pool".

Chen L: Good call. We can separate `hint` (friendly) and `internal_label` (for ops/dashboard joins). So `hint` for end-users, `internal_label` for telemetry joins.

Samir: Example payload idea:
```json
{
  "code": 429,
  "category": "quota",
  "hint": "usage limit reached for this key",
  "internal_label": "tenant_quota_exhausted",
  "quota_bucket": "per_minute_default",
  "trace_id": "rtr_abc123"
}
```

Maria H: This looks good. Two questions: 1) how do we handle soft-degrades vs hard errors? 2) sampling/volume — we can't send `trace_id` on every single token error, too much volume.

Lee: For soft-degrades we should use category: "degrade" and include a `degrade_level` field (1..3). For volume, agree — `trace_id` should be optional and only emitted when `debug=true` or for sampled requests. Add `sample_rate_hint` to telemetry so console knows how representative the traces are.

Anya: Console needs badges: green/yellow/red derived from category+degrade_level. We'll map: terminal -> red, transient/degrade(level1) -> yellow, quota-> amber. Also want link to a quick runbook — that will be an ops annotation keyed by `internal_label`.

Ops-bot: deploy:status: canary-rollout v0.33 started on us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T15:01:04Z :rocket:

Samir: Important for SDKs: provide a helper `shouldRetry(error)` that interprets category + degrade_level + code. That way client apps don't have to parse text hints. SDK will expose: `error.category`, `error.hint`, `error.retryAfter` (if present).

Chen L: I'll draft RFC with final JSON schema and a compatibility plan for 2 SDK versions. Compatibility: new fields are additive, old SDKs should fallback to `code` + `hint`.

Maria H: Action items: Chen to RFC by EOD Thu, Samir to draft SDK helper prototypes, Lee to add `route_id` tagging to routing logs, Anya to mock console badges. Who can own sample gating for trace_id?

Lee: I'll own trace sampling config. Plan: default 0.5% for production, 5% for canary, toggleable via feature-flag.

Anya: Mockups by Friday. Use `internal_label` to link runbooks.

Samir: One last thought — include `user_hint_code` (short string) so frontend can i18n messaging without parsing full `hint`. Eg `USER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. Then consoles/SDKs map to localized text.

Maria H: Love that. Final checklist in RFC: schema, sampling rules, SDK contract, console mapping table, rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 100%).

Chen L: Will post RFC thread later today, pinging everyone. @ops-bot can you create a ticket with summary: "Error contract RFC" and link once it's up? :memo:

Ops-bot: ticket:create: #INFR-9123 "Error contract RFC" created and assigned to Chen L — https://tickets.internal/INFR-9123

Lee: Thanks. Quick reminder — we should include a backwards compatibility note for webhooks and any third-party partners that parse our old freeform messages.

Anya: noted, will include migration copy for partners in RFC.

Maria H: Thanks team. If RFC lands today I'll review and we can kickoff canary after console mock is attached.

Chen L: RFC posted: https://docs.redwood/internal/rfcs/error-client-contract — comments welcome.

Samir: Commented with SDK stubs.

Anya: Commented on badge colors and runbook link UI.

Lee: Added sampling config PR: https://git.redwood/ops/trace-sampling/pull/45

Maria H: Moving to follow-up thread for signoffs. Great work. :clap:
